correctness.rationale: On fixed bi-infinite grid, Steffen limiter has same-sign secants and partial slopes in [0,2]. Hermite derivative A=6t(1−t), B=3t²−4t+1, C=3t²−2t has ∫|B|=∫|C|=8/27 and A+aB+bC≥0 for 0≤a,b≤2 by checking four polynomial corners. Perturbing just one secant gives central TV h_i|δs_i| and neighboring TV ≤(16/27)(h_{i-1}+h_{i+1})|δs_i|. Telescope finite secant changes and pass to bi-infinite ℓ¹ by Fatou; this proves upper bound. Choose adjacent secants large positive compared to the center so both strict selector branches are 2s_i, giving exact lower bound for each i, including infinite unbounded mesh-ratio case. Independent exact basis/abs integrals and h triples (2,1,3) give 107/27. Individual signals are cellwise monotone, so one-input TV preservation is separate from two-input bound.
